rule: HBM-BIND-CMP 10-26 (COORD ruling 4): an OUTPUT_UNREAD of the B2 top may stand only if declared here with a proof; b2_top.py --declared-unread moves an exact match (inst.port + unread/width) to OUTPUT_UNREAD_DECLARED and reports a declaration that matches nothing as DECLARED_STALE. Classes: REDUNDANT (bit-exact function of consumed outputs), DEBUG_ONLY (observability, no on-die or host-path consumer by design), UNUSED_DOMAIN.
